features.feature: Build a review evidence pack citing the target document state, current diff/status, and code-backed truth sources (lifecycle gates, reviewer lanes, review_run/finding/pass, init-check gate, evaluator save/eval-evidence, milestone_status UX, prompt registry/agent_prompt, process-fact registry, command policy, CLI docs)
Evidence pack prefers current code facts over stale planning prose and records when a referenced behavior is only planned
Evidence pack does not treat prompt text, raw evaluator JSON, or host-review prose as gate evidence

Run 3x2 independent review: three host labels (Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, Antigravity CLI) x two lenses (lifecycle/gate correctness + prompt/routing/UX practicality) = six recorded host/lens findings
Review findings cite concrete project evidence rather than accepting advice or prompt prose without verification
Antigravity CLI is scoped to this explicit user-requested 3x2 review and does not rewrite global default host policy (Agy not made global primary)
Reconcile 3x2 findings into an actionable optimization ledger: deduplicate overlapping findings, classify each accept/reject/defer, attach owner milestone/story impact and evidence references
Deferred/rejected suggestions include explicit code or policy evidence; ledger does not hide host disagreement or collapse conflicts into vague consensus
Record the INIT product-reviewer medium advisory about Antigravity CLI default-host wording in the optimization ledger
features.source: decision.json#preMortem[1].mitigation (ledger is the natural home; substance also covered by CHK-002/CHK-004 — implicit, not an explicit checklist line)

features.feature: Apply approved documentation optimizations to the target document only, without weakening INIT/REVIEW/TEST/DONE hard lifecycle gates
Preserve reviewer-run binding, evaluator raw-vs-saved evidence boundary, legacy read compatibility, canonical proof-or-stop-* writes, and no direct story-file mutation by prompts
Preserve milestone_status as the mandatory progress UX source rather than agent-handwritten status
If a finding implies a future code change, record it as a future implementation story rather than changing code in B-2861

Produce a DONE optimization table listing every concrete optimization with reason, supporting project evidence, motivating 3x2 host/lens finding, and affected contract area (milestone order / agent responsibility / IO contract / UX contract / validation coverage)

DONE table distinguishes concrete applied optimizations from deferred/rejected suggestions and cannot claim completion unless the document contains/accompanies the evidence-backed table; does not imply unimplemented code shipped

features.excluded_by: Documentation-only story: code is read as evidence, not modified (understanding.json facts/constraints; decision.json principle 3). Code gaps become future implementation stories.

features.feature: Direct read/write of docs/story or tests/fixtures files
features.excluded_by: Out of scope by constraint: CLI-mediated story artifact discipline; prompts/story must not directly mutate these files.

features.feature: Rewriting global default host policy to make Antigravity CLI a global primary host
features.excluded_by: Explicitly out of scope: story keeps Agy scoped to this 3x2 review and preserves accurate default-host guidance (decision A rejects options that alter global policy).
